{{Quote|Get ready to crash! Get ready to burrrrn!|[[Boles Roor/Legends|Boles Roor]]|<ref name="PT" />}}
'''Sneevels''' were a furry, [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sneeve/Legends|Sneeve]]. They were characterized by their oversized, portly heads, monochromatic eyes, and distinctive smell, which they used for communication. Most Sneevels were extraordinarily nimble.

The Sneevels were famed for their daredevil tendencies, which led them into thrill-seeking occupations. When the species was discovered by [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], they were scouting their planet and system using dangerous native technology. With the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] technology offered by the Duros, the Sneevels joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. They took advantage of their new opportunities to pursue their interests on other planets &mdash; although they showed little interest in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Politics/Legends|politics]], they gravitated toward new chances to take new risks in activities such as [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]].

Sneevels actively took part in galactic politics during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] that preceded the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During this time, the planet supported the Galactic Republic, the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] and the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] later tried to confine the Sneevels to their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. The restrictions, however, merely served to drive several members of the species to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

The Sneevel [[Boles Roor/Legends|Boles Roor]] found fame as a [[Glimmik/Legends|glimmik]] singer and [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] in the latter days of the Old Republic. Another Sneevel of note during this time was [[Jollin Resbin]], who served as [[Senator/Legends|senator]] for the [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. Later, Sneevels were seen on [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Sneevel-SWJarJarsJourneyAdventureBook.png|thumb|left|upright|Sneevels had shaggy fur, large ears, and formidable teeth.]]
Sneevels were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who ranged from 1.6 to 2 meters in height.<ref name="AA" /> Their bodies were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]], with four long limbs that ended in five digits with nails. They had long tails.<ref name="PT" /> Members of the species were covered in fur that varied from blond to black and tended to become white with age.<ref name="AA" /> One famous<ref name="PT" /> representative of the species, the podracer [[Boles Roor/Legends|Boles Roor]],<ref name="EN" /> wore little clothing, went about barefoot, and bound his tail with a cord.<ref name="PT" />

Sneevels had large heads distinguished by portly muzzles, hairy brows, and manes of bristly hair.<ref name="AA" /> The bottom canines protruded from their wide mouths even when closed. The other teeth were smaller, and their tongues were pink.<ref name="PT" /> Some Sneevels, such as Boles Roor, braided the hair hanging from their jaw and decorated it with jewelry.<ref name="AA" /><ref name="PT" /> At least in some cases, a Sneevel's eyes had irises and scleras that were different shades of the same color; the pupils were darker or black.<ref name="AA" /><ref name="PT" /> Non-Sneevels often found them unattractive.<ref name="EIRGSG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> Their relatively small bodies were nimbler than a typical [[Human/Legends|Human's]]. This, combined with their naturally high reflexes, gave them exceptionally good reaction time, the ability to deftly dodge in combat, and outstanding aim with ranged weapons. The average Sneevel's lifespan was 76 standard years.<ref name="AA" />

Sneevels exuded a strong odor that varied with their mood,<ref name="AA" /> particularly when they were either strongly enraged, entertained nervous or scared.<ref name="EN">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', entry "Sneevel".</ref> This provided clues about their emotional state to any who could smell them and knew how to interpret the scent,<ref name="AA" /> making an individual Sneevel's emotional state obvious to any other Sneevel.<ref name="EN" /> The species communicated information odoriferously, and their native language, [[Snee (language)|Snee]], partially relied on such "mood musks." Other species commonly considered the Sneevels' scent overpowering and malodorous, and some [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] might even collapse if they lingered too long in the presence of a member of the species.<ref name="AA" />

Sneevels were [[Diet/Legends|omnivores]], and their large mouths and powerful jaws allowed them to eat a wide variety of foods. Some members of the species were prone to not only eat cooked food but also the dishes upon which it was served.<ref name="JJJ" />

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|Muh ''first number'' is about ''courage!'' It's ''not'' dedicated to all the ''spineless rejects'' who just ''watch'' the Boonta!|Boles Roor|<ref name="PT" />}}
[[File:Sneevel_Racer_2.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Side view of a Sneevel.]]
Sneevels felt a need to live adventurously,<ref name="AA" /> seeking fast thrills<ref name="EN" /> and emotional highs. Consequently, many died from risky pursuits. Members of the species were inclined toward dangerous careers, such as hyperspace-[[Hyperspace route/Legends|route]] exploration, extreme sports, and hazardous [[Scientist/Legends|scientific]] research on [[quantum field]]s. For some Sneevels, devotion to a noble cause compelled this thrill-seeking, but for many more, a selfish desire for personal excitement was the main driving force. Although they had little interest in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Politics/Legends|politics]] or the galaxy beyond their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], many still commonly learned [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] as a second language. Their native tongue was known as Snee.<ref name="AA" />

As a rule, Sneevels were not known to be amiable or social, and their surliness made them closer in temperament to [[Dashade/Legends|Dashades]] than most other species.<ref name="AA" /> Still, some Sneevels gained success at social vocations despite this antisocial penchant, celebrity Boles Roor being the prime example.<ref name="DBBR" /><ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref><ref name="PT" />

==History==
Sneevels established a technological society in isolation on [[Sneeve/Legends|Sneeve]], their homeworld<ref name="AA" /> located in the [[Sneeve system/Legends|Sneeve system]],<ref name="atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> in the [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="H55">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|regional/1359_1.html|Campaigning Reports from the Mid Rim}}</ref> Their pioneering proclivities led Sneevel explorers from their homeworld's highest summit to its deepest trench. They developed a tricky means of [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] space travel that relied on shoddy submersible vehicles attached to rocket boosters and used it to explore their home system.<ref name="AA" />

Soon before [[14,000 BBY]],<ref name="EN" /> [[Duro/Legends|Duros]] explorers discovered Sneeve and provided the native Sneevels with [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]], which led to the Sneevels joining the galactic community soon afterwards. Later, Duros and Human traders provided the species with more efficient [[Realspace/Legends|space]] travel technology. Although the Sneevels found these safer vehicles to be more boring than their own, they adapted to settle their [[Star system/Legends|system]] and expand to other parts of the galaxy.<ref name="AA" />

[[File:Boles_roor.jpg|thumb|left|[[Boles Roor/Legends|Boles Roor]], celebrity Sneevel.]]

Sneevels enjoyed pursuing new experiences throughout the galaxy, and they became leading figures in daredevil occupations, including dangerous sports such as [[horizon skimming]] and [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]], high-speed races that could easily kill an unprepared pilot.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}} shows the death of pilot [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]]; the danger of podracing is expanded in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 45|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #45'']] and [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 49|''#49'']], among others.</ref> They also excelled in creative fields and achieved success in the fields of visual arts, [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] production, and [[Music/Legends|music]]. Politics was too prosaic for their interests, and few showed any real flair for it.<ref name="AA" /> Nevertheless, Sneeve had representation in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] in the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="H55" />

In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]],<ref name="Raxus">{{DB|location|raxusprime|Raxus Prime}}</ref> charismatic secessionist Count [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] began the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and thousands of planetary systems with important military resources rallied to his side.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' et al.</ref> With the Separatists being perceived as a [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|threat]] in the Republic, several proponents suggested the creation of a [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] to provide an army to the Republic, a matter that was to be decided in a Senatorial vote.<ref name="hnn">[[HoloNet News (original website)|''HoloNet News'' website]] et al.</ref> During this time, Sneeve was an active supporter of the Military Creation Act and campaigned to attract other potential allies under [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Jollin Resbin]].<ref name="H55" /> The world also joined the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]], a non-profit organization to aid people displaced by the conflict. As the secession of world after world brought the number of displaced beings to a breaking point, Sneeve and nine other [[Planet/Legends|planets]] formed the Refugee Resettlement Coalition and relaxed their local immigration restrictions to take in more refugees.<ref name="H52">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|regional/13418_1.html|Mid Rim Worlds Open Ports to Refugees}}</ref>

The [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] began in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] as a direct consequence of the Separatist Crisis<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> and, when they ended in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Republic was replaced by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> This new government instituted several new measures detrimental to aliens.<ref name="AITE">''[[Aliens in the Empire]]'' et al.</ref> Among them, the Empire tried to restrict the Sneevels to their homeworld. This had the opposite effect, however, as running the metaphorical blockade acted as an agitating intoxicant to the daredevil beings. The Empire appointed a local [[Governor/Legends|governor]] and approved laws to tighten interstellar travel from Sneeve, moves the Sneevels regarded as intolerable oppression. Many joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], not necessarily because they had any interest in overthrowing the Empire, but because they felt imprisoned on their own planet or wanted the excitement the Rebellion offered. Rebel Sneevels embraced their daredevil nature in service to the Alliance even at the cost of their own lives, and more than a few came to be remembered as martyrs for the cause. Many others died gratuitously in avoidable circumstances.<ref name="AA" />

==Sneevels in the galaxy==
[[File:BolesRoorGuitar-PodracingTales.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Boles Roor/Legends|Boles Roor]] in concert.]]
{{Quote|It's two-time winner Boles Roor. This Sneevel's got money to burn, and he's put it all in his Podracer.|[[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Beed]]|audio=BolesRoorAnnounce.flac|<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: Racer">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]</ref>}}
Sneevel explorers commonly felt restricted on their planet and jumped to hyperspace looking for adventure. Members of the species became prominent [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], artists, scientists, and athletes.<ref name="AA" /> One example was Boles Roor,<ref name="DBBR" /> who was successful both as a renowned [[Glimmik/Legends|glimmik]] singer<ref name="CCW" /> and seasoned podracer. Roor won the prestigious [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] on two occasions and was never defeated by the local favorite, [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]].<ref name="DBBR" /><ref name="IWE1">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Unidentified Sneevel announcer|Sneevel]] worked as an announcer for podraces aboard a [[leisure satellite]]. In this capacity, he was present in orbit around the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], announcing the [[Spiral Double Cup]], when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] stopped a plot by [[Droid/Legends|droids]] allied with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to destroy the Coruscant [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] with a giant laser.<ref name="Leisure">{{TCWComicCite|6.22|Leisure}}</ref>

Although Sneevels and politics rarely mixed,<ref name="AA" /> one in particular, Jollin Resbin, had been elected senator of the Kastolar sector by 22 BBY.<ref name="H55" /> Sneevels also worked with the Rebel Alliance during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], both to fight what they considered oppression on their planet and for the simple expedient of risking their lives in hazardous derring-do.<ref name="AA" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] encountered two Sneevels (apparently ones unassociated with the Alliance) in a tent on the planet [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]],<ref name="RFT">''[[Rebel Force: Target]]''</ref> far from the world where the Empire had wanted to restrict them.<ref name="AA" /> When a [[Phlog/Legends|Phlog]] mocked [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] podracing skills, a full-scale brawl erupted in which the Sneevels joined in. The two aliens rushed Solo and his companion, but were dodged and then quickly defeated.<ref name="RFT" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Just call him Shaggy.|Caption to Sneevel concept art|<ref name="Galactic Gallery">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/galactic/2005/06/galactic20050601.html|series=Galactic Gallery|text=Danger is Afoot}}</ref>}}
[[File:Boles_Roor_concept_art.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Sneevel concept art by [[Terryl Whitlatch|Whitlatch]].]]
The podracer Boles Roor, created for [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], was the first Sneevel to appear in a ''Star Wars'' source. [[Terryl Whitlatch]] sketched the character,<ref name="DBBR" /> and the production team built a puppet of the character, but only its face appears in the film as [[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed Annodue]] welcomes spectators to the races.<ref name="TPM" /> This podrace announcer later calls out Roor's name during the film's podracing sequence, but Roor himself does not appear on screen.<ref name="DBBR" /> Roor is again mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Phantom Menace'' novelization]] and was first depicted in [[Star Wars: Episode I — The Phantom Menace (comic series)|the comic adaptation]]. His appearance there is based on the puppet, although the artist has added a horn above his nose. The [[Databank (original)|Databank]] at [[StarWars.com]] first identified Roor's species, using again the picture of the puppet, and the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying supplement]] ''[[Alien Anthology]]'' ([[October]] [[2001]]), by [[Steve Miller]] and [[Owen K.C. Stephens]], first provided the species' background.

Sources disagree regarding the galactic region in which Sneeve was located. ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'' (October [[2000]]) and ''Alien Anthology'' both place Sneeve in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], but the website [[HoloNet News (original website)|''HoloNet News'']] ([[2002]]) and [[Star Wars Insider 65|''Star Wars Insider'' 65]] ([[February]] [[2003]]) locate it in the Mid Rim. Given that the ''HoloNet News'' releases and the ''Insider'' article are the most recent sources, this article assumes Sneeve is indeed in the Mid Rim.

In the ''Star Wars Roleplaying Game'' from [[Wizards of the Coast]], players may take on the role of Sneevel characters. ''Alien Anthology'' presents game statistics for the species, which indicate that Sneevels are incredibly agile but suffer several other penalties in compensation. In fact, Sneevels receive a +6 natural bonus to their Dexterity attribute, the highest bonus to this attribute of any species in the game. A Sneevel character is also available in the video-game ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'', in this case professional podracer Boles Roor. In this game, his podracer cannot cool properly, probably due to the Sneevel neglecting the maintenance tasks and being a bad mechanic as described in [[Secrets of Tatooine|other]] sources. While Roor's pod is featured in the sequel of the game, ''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]'', the Sneevel himself does not appear in it.

The children's [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jar Jar's Journey Adventure Book]]'', released in [[1999]] by [[Lucas Learning]], features a cartoon image of a Sneevel. The character appears in a mini-game in which the player must match disparate heads, torsos, and legs to create cohesive characters; success causes the mini-game's host, the [[Troig/Legends|Troig]] [[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fode and Beed Annodue]], to comment. In contrast to the other descrambled characters in the matching game, the Troig claims not to recognize the Sneevel and instead expresses his wish to never meet the furry creature in a dark alley.<ref name="JJJ" />
